description:
Sonic's adventures don't go quite to plan, as he's killed by a bot in Green Hill Zone - but what follows is a fate far worse than the death he expected as he finds himself in a bleak purgatory filled with alternate dead versions of himself. Faced with the complicated task of finding their way home, the Sonics discover that they could have greater purpose as their actions begin the manifest on the mortal plain...
